notes.title: Patch Notes – Latest Update Drop 1.24 for Bitmagic Mini!
notes.notes:
We’ve been busy behind the scenes, and it’s time to show what’s new. Here’s what’s landing in this update:

AI-Generated Game Background 
Experience the game from a whole new perspective with a dynamic, AI-created background that brings more atmosphere and depth to every session.

New Gameplay Mode: Collection Competition
Think you’ve got what it takes to outplay the NPCs? Challenge them in our brand-new Collection Competition mode and earn your bragging rights.

New Landing Page + UI Rework
The front end just got a facelift. Smoother, sharper, and built to get you into the action faster.

Faster Loading Times 
Less waiting, more playing. We’ve cut down load times across the board so you can dive in quicker than ever.

Go to https://mini.bitmagic.ai/ and see it all for yourself!

notes.title: Bitmagic Mini Version 1.1 Release Notes
notes.notes:
New Features

Game Sharing: Easily share your creations with friends and the community!
Non-Player Characters (NPCs): Add NPCs to your world to bring it to life.
Breakable Objects: Smash and destroy objects for even more interactive gameplay.
Carry Objects: Pick up and move objects to solve puzzles and create fun interactions.
New Landing Page: Enjoy a refreshed look that welcomes you into Bitmagic Mini.

Performance Improvements

Optimized for Low-End Devices: Experience smoother gameplay even on less powerful devices.

UI & UX Enhancements

Improved Interface: Various enhancements make creating and navigating your world easier than ever.

Bug Fixes & Stability

General Stability Improvements: Enjoy a more reliable adventure with overall performance boosts.
Additional Bug Fixes: Minor issues have been resolved to ensure smoother gameplay and performance.

Share your thoughts on our Discord Feedback Channel
Play Bitmagic Mini Now at https://mini.bitmagic.ai/

notes.title: Update 72 – Release Notes
notes.notes:
Indoor Prompting Improvements
Improved indoor generation with better accuracy for creating rooms and objects.

Weather Effect Improvements
Weather effects are now smoother and visually enhanced, adding more life to environments.

Animal Feeding
Prompt to add food items, like “add carrot.” Animals now interact with edible items for added immersion.

Survey and Discord Links
Quickly share feedback through integrated survey links or join the discussion in our Discord community.

Discord Feedback Channel > Go to Discord Feedback Channel
Feedback Survey > Go to Feedback Survey

Bug Fixes
Resolved several bugs and stability issues to improve performance and overall gameplay.

notes.title: Update 70 Release Notes
notes.notes:
We're happy to bring you our latest update with some new features:

Dragons
Dragons have arrived in the game! (More details coming soon)

Mission System
Introduced the first version of our mission system
Currently features item-finding missions.
Test it out and let us know what you think!

Enhanced World Generation
NPCs and animals will now spawn inside generated buildings.

Known Issues
Please report any bugs or issues you encounter with the new features in our feedback channel on Discord.

We're actively monitoring your feedback and will continue to improve these features in upcoming updates. Join our Discord for discussions and the latest news!

notes.title: Update 68 release notes
notes.notes:
New Features

Indoor Prompting
Create and explore customized indoor environments with enhanced options for generating and personalizing rooms, objects, and indoor scenes, adding a new layer of immersion to your gameplay.

Interactive Tutorial
Get a smoother start with our newly revamped tutorial! This step-by-step guide is designed to walk you through core game mechanics and new features, ensuring you make the most out of your Bitmagic experience.

Visual Enhancements

Improved Visuals
Enjoy sharper graphics and smoother animations across environments. Upgrades to lighting, textures, and character models make the game more vivid and engaging.

Bug Fixes

General Bug Fixes
We've resolved various bugs and stability issues reported by our community to improve the overall game performance and experience.

Technical Update

Unity Engine Upgrade
Bitmagic is now powered by Unity 6, providing better performance, enhanced visuals, and the framework needed to support future features.

notes.title: Release Update 66
notes.notes:
Main features:
With this update, we’re introducing some exciting features to enhance your experience, starting with new and improved weather effects that bring more realism to the game world. You’ll also have the ability to remove objects, giving you greater control over your environment. Additionally, we’ve added 3 brand-new game worlds for you to explore and enjoy.

Minor Improvements:
We’ve made several UI and UX enhancements for smoother and more intuitive gameplay.

Bug Fixes:
A solution for the visual glitch that occurred when driving cars.

Jump in and explore all the new content in Update 66!

– The Bitmagic Team

notes.title: Release Update 64
notes.notes:
Main Features:

 Item Interaction: You can now easily carry and manipulate objects in the game! Just press F to pick up items and interact with them, unlocking new ways to play and explore.
 Dynamic Objects Support: Get creative with new dynamic objects! We've added fun elements like trampolines that launch players up to 50 meters into the air—introducing exciting new gameplay mechanics.


Minor Improvements:

 Enhanced Customization: Players can now change the colors of objects in the game, providing even more freedom to personalize the game environment.
 Smarter Suggested Prompts: Improved suggestions now offer a more intuitive experience when interacting with objects or navigating through the game.
 Cooldown Feature: A new cooldown system has been implemented to maintain balanced gameplay and prevent rapid spamming of certain actions.


Bug Fixes:
Various gameplay issues have been addressed to ensure a smoother, more enjoyable experience.

Jump into Release 64 and explore all the new possibilities!

notes.title: Update 60: Release Notes
notes.notes:
First off, we’ve added an in-game chat feature, making it easier for you to communicate with other players while playing. Whether coordinating strategies or just having a friendly conversation, this will enhance your multiplayer experience.

A new addition is that NPCs can now be created in multiplayer! This is the first step toward making the world feel more alive during multiplayer sessions.

We’ve also expanded the game world with more buildings and cars, adding new layers of depth and realism to your environment. On top of that, there have been several UI improvements aimed at making the interface smoother and more intuitive for players.

For those of you who love multiplayer, we’ve made a lot of stability improvements to ensure a more reliable and seamless experience during your sessions. Additionally, there have been major pathfinding improvements, making character and vehicle movement more fluid and intelligent.

Finally, we’ve tackled a lot of other bug fixes to ensure a smoother overall gameplay experience. And last but not least, Mac users can finally play too!

Thanks for your continued support, and we can’t wait to see you in-game! 😎 

Bitmagic Team

notes.title: Update 58: Release Notes
notes.notes:
We’re happy to introduce the first version of our new game mode, Co-Prompting! Now you can join a game and collaborate with others on prompts, adding a fresh layer of fun to the experience. Along with this, we’ve revamped the in-game HUD to enhance your overall gameplay.

In multiplayer, cars and animals are now fully functional, bringing more depth and excitement to your sessions. We’ve also addressed various bugs to ensure smoother performance across the board.

Please note that the game creation and “My Games” view are disabled for time being as we focus our efforts on refining Co-Prompting. For Mac users, this update is slightly delayed, but we’ll keep you updated on its availability.

Thank you for your support, and we hope you enjoy the latest features! 

Bitmagic Team
